description: This file defines a Composable UI screen for creating or editing a recipe within an Android Jetpack Compose app. It manages UI state, interacts with a ViewModel to load and save recipes, and dynamically updates UI elements based on user input.

methods.name: CreateEditScreen
methods.description: A Composable function that provides a screen for creating or editing recipes, managing form state, loading existing recipe data for editing, and handling user submissions.
